claim: The article should centre on access to the first job, rather than China as a validated TVET model.
Evidence of a shift towards senior workers exists in some samples; a universal experience advantage or explanation of its cause is not established.
AI adoption has not produced a uniform observed graduate or entry-level employment outcome across the inspected settings.
The inspected evidence does not establish a Malaysian TVET boom, an AI-proof career list, or Malaysian graduate displacement forecasts.
